name: Does the man get his umbrella back?
trans: 那个男人能拿回他的伞吗？

name: My coat and my umbrella please.
trans: 请给我我的外套和雨伞。

name: Here's your umbrella and your coat.
Nice to see you too Steven.
trans: 也很高兴见到你，史蒂文。

name: What colour is Anna's hat?
trans: 安娜的帽子是什么颜色的？

name: What colour's your new dress?
trans: 你的新裙子是什么颜色的？

name: It's the same colour.
trans: 它的颜色和我的帽子一样。

name: That is a lovely hat!
trans: 那是一顶非常漂亮的帽子！

name: Is there a problem with the Customs officer?
trans: 这个海关官员有问题吗？

name: Are your friends Danish too?
trans: 你的朋友们也是丹麦人吗？

name: Are your friends tourists too?
trans: 你们的朋友也是游客吗？

name: What are Michael Baker and Jeremy Short's jobs?
trans: 迈克尔·贝克（Michael Baker）和杰里米·肖特（Jeremy Short）分别从事什么工作？

name: Come and meet our employees Mr.Richards.
trans: 请来认识一下我们的员工，理查兹先生。

name: He's our office assistant.
trans: 他是我们的办公室助理。

name: Why do the children thank their mother?
trans: 为什么孩子们要感谢他们的母亲呢？

name: There's an ice cream man.
trans: 有一个卖冰淇淋的叔叔。

name: Which book does the man want?
Give me a book please, Jane.
No, not that one. The red one.
trans: “不，不是那一本。是红色的那本。”

name: Which glasses does the man want?
trans: 那个男人想要哪副眼镜？

name: Give me some glasses please, Jane.
The ones on the shelf.
trans: 那些放在架子上的东西。

name: Yes, please.
trans: 好的，请告诉我您需要翻译的内容吧。

name: What colour is the electric cooker?
trans: 这个电饭煲是什么颜色的？

name: Mrs. Smith's kitchen is small.
trans: 史密斯太太的厨房很小。

name: There is a refrigerator in the kitchen.
There is an electric cooker in the kitchen.
There is a table in the middle of the room.
There is a bottle on the table.
There is a cup on the table, too.
Mrs. Smith's living room is large.
trans: 史密斯太太的客厅非常大。

name: There is a television in the room.
The television is near the window.
There are some magazines on the television.
trans: 电视上有一些杂志节目（或：电视屏幕上显示着一些杂志的相关内容）。

name: There is a table in the room.
There are some newspapers on the table.
There are some armchairs in the room.
The armchairs are near the table.
trans: 那些扶手椅都放在桌子旁边。

name: There is a stereo in the room.
trans: 房间里有一台立体声音响。

name: The stereo is near the door.
trans: 音响设备放在靠近门的地方。

name: There are some books on the stereo.
trans: 有一些书放在音响设备上。

name: There are some pictures in the room.
The pictures are on the wall.
trans: 那些照片被挂在墙上了。

name: How must Amy clean the floor?
trans: 艾米应该怎样打扫地板呢？

name: This bedroom's very untidy.
trans: 这个卧室非常乱糟糟的。

name: What must I do, Mrs. Jones?
Open the window and air the room.
Then put these clothes in the wardrobe.
trans: 然后把这些衣服放进衣柜里。

name: Dust the dressing table.
trans: 最后擦擦梳妆台上的灰尘。

name: Is the cat climbing the tree?
Is Tim in the garden, too?
The dog's in the garden, too.
It's running across the grass.
trans: 它正在草地上跑来跑去。

name: It is a fine day today.
There are some clouds in the sky,
but the sun is shining.
trans: 但是太阳依然在照耀着。

name: Mr. Jones is with his family.
trans: 琼斯先生和他的家人在一起。

name: They are walking over the bridge.
There are some boats on the river.
Mr. Jones and his wife are looking at them.
trans: 琼斯先生和他的妻子正在看着它们。

name: Sally is looking at a big ship.
trans: 莎莉正在看一艘很大的船。

name: The ship is going under the bridge.
Tim is looking at an aeroplane.
The aeroplane is flying over the river.
trans: 那架飞机正在河的上空飞行。

name: Are the children coming out of the park or going into it?
trans: 孩子们是从公园里出来，还是正要进入公园呢？

name: This is a photograph of our village.
trans: 这是一张我们村庄的照片。

name: Our village is in a valley.
trans: 我们的村庄位于一个山谷里。

name: The village is on a river.
trans: 这个村庄坐落在一条河边。

name: Here is another photograph of the village.
trans: 这是另一张村庄的照片。

name: My wife and I are walking along the banks of the river.
trans: 我和我的妻子正在河边散步。

name: There is a boy in the water.
He is swimming across the river.
It is beside a park.
trans: 它位于一个公园的旁边。

name: The park is on the right.
Some children are coming out of the building.
trans: 一些孩子正从大楼里走出来。

name: Some of them are going into the park.
trans: 其中一些人正前往公园。

name: What is Susan's favourite colour?
trans: 苏珊最喜欢的颜色是什么？

name: Give me that hammer please, Dan.
trans: 请把那把锤子递给我，丹。

name: The big one.
trans: 那个重要的（或大型的）东西。

name: What are you going to do now, George?
trans: 乔治，你现在打算做什么？

name: What colour are you going to paint it?
trans: 你打算把它涂成什么颜色？

name: I'm going to paint it pink.
Pink's her favourite colour.
trans: 粉色是她最喜欢的颜色。

name: Where does Sam put the vase in the end?
trans: 最后萨姆把花瓶放在了哪里？

name: What are you going to do with that vase, Penny?
trans: 佩妮，你打算怎么处理那个花瓶？

name: I'm going to put it on this table, Sam.
trans: “我要把它放在这张桌子上，”萨姆说。

name: What are you going to do with it?
I'm going to put it here, in front of the window.
trans: “我要把它放在这里，窗子前面。”

name: Put it here, on this shelf.
trans: 把它放在这里，这个架子上。

name: It's a lovely vase.
trans: 这是一个很漂亮的花瓶。

name: Who is the tin of tobacco for?
trans: 这罐烟草是给谁用的呢？

name: A quarter of a pound of tea.
Is that tin of tobacco for me?
Well, it's certainly not for me!
How do you know Sam doesn't make the tea very often?
trans: 你怎么知道山姆不经常泡茶的？

name: Can you make the tea, Sam?
Yes, of course I can, Penny.
Is there any water in this kettle?
It's over there, behind the teapot.
I can see the teapot, but I can't see the tea.
trans: 我能看到茶壶，但看不到茶。

name: Ah yes, I can see it now.
There are some in the cupboard.
Why can't Pamela type the letter?
trans: 为什么帕梅拉打不出这个字母呢？

name: Can you come here a minute please, Bob?
She's in her office, sir.
trans: 她现在在她的办公室里，先生。

name: Can she type this letter for me?
Can you type this letter for the boss please, Pamela?
trans: 帕梅拉，你能帮老板把这封信打出来吗？

name: I can't type this letter.
trans: 我无法打出这封信的内容。

name: How does Ann like her coffee?
Yes, please, Christine.
trans: 是的，请给我来一杯，克里斯汀。

name: I don't like milk in my coffee.
trans: 我不喜欢在咖啡里加牛奶。

name: Do you want any meat today, Mrs. Bird?
trans: 伯德夫人，今天您想要吃点肉吗？

name: Yes, please.
trans: 好的，请告诉我您需要翻译的内容吧。

name: Do you want beef or lamb?
This lamb's very good.
trans: 这只小羊非常可爱（或：这只小羊非常棒）。

name: I like lamb, but my husband doesn't.
trans: 我喜欢羊肉，但我丈夫不喜欢。

name: This is a nice piece.
trans: 这是一件很不错的作品。

name: And a pound of mince, too.
Do you want a chicken, Mrs. Bird?
trans: 伯德夫人，您想要鸡肉吗？

name: To tell you the truth, Mrs. Bird,
Does it ever snow in Greece?
What's the climate like in your country?
trans: 你们国家的气候是怎样的？

name: What's the weather like in spring?
It's always warm in April and May, but it rains sometimes.
trans: 四月和五月总是很温暖，但有时会下雨。

name: It's always hot in June, July and August.
trans: 六月、七月和八月总是很热。

name: Is it cold or warm in autumn?
It's always warm in September and October.
trans: 九月份和十月份总是很暖和的。

name: It's often cold in November and it rains sometimes.
trans: 十一月份天气通常很冷，有时还会下雨。

name: Is it very cold in winter?
It's often cold in December, January and February.
trans: 十二月、一月和二月通常都很冷。

name: What is the favourite subject of conversation in England?
trans: 在英格兰，人们最喜欢谈论的话题是什么？

name: What's the climate like in your country?
trans: 你们国家的气候是怎样的？

name: It's mild, but it's not always pleasant.
trans: 天气虽然还算温和，但并不总是让人感到舒适（或：天气虽然不冷，但并不总是令人愉悦）。

name: The weather's often cold in the North and windy in the East.
trans: 北方的天气通常很冷，而东方的天气则多风。

name: It's often wet in the West and sometimes warm in the South.
trans: 在西边，天气常常潮湿；而在南方，有时天气会比较温暖。

name: Which seasons do you like best?
The days are long and the nights are short.
trans: 白天的时间很长，夜晚的时间很短。

name: The sun rises early and sets late.
trans: 太阳升起得很早，落山得很晚。

name: I don't like autumn and winter.
The days are short and the nights are long.
trans: 白天的时间很短，夜晚的时间很长。

name: The sun rises late and sets early.
trans: 太阳升起得很晚，落山得很早。

name: Our climate is not very good, but it's certainly interesting.
trans: 我们的气候不是很好，但确实很有趣。

name: It's our favourite subject of conversation.
trans: 这是我们最喜欢谈论的话题。

name: When do the children do their homework?
trans: 孩子们什么时候做作业？

name: The Sawyers live at 87 King Street.
trans: 索耶一家住在国王街87号。

name: In the morning, Mr. Sawyer goes to work and the children go to school.
trans: 早上，索耶先生去上班，孩子们去上学。

name: Their father takes them to school every day.
trans: 他们的父亲每天都会送他们去学校。

name: Mrs. Sawyer stays at home every day.
trans: 索耶夫人每天都待在家里。

name: She always eats her lunch at noon.
In the afternoon, she usually sees her friends.
trans: 下午，她通常会和朋友见面。

name: In the evening, the children come home from school.
trans: 傍晚时分，孩子们从学校回家了。

name: Mr. Sawyer comes home from work.
trans: 索耶先生下班后回到了家。

name: At night, the children always do their homework.
trans: 晚上，孩子们总是会做他们的作业。

name: Then they go to bed.
trans: 然后他们就上床睡觉了。

name: Mr. Sawyer usually reads his newspaper, but sometimes he and his wife watch television.
trans: 索耶先生通常会读报纸，但有时候他和他妻子也会一起看电视。

name: What is Mr. Sawyer doing tonight?
trans: 索耶先生今晚在做什么？

name: The children go to school by car every day,
trans: 孩子们每天都乘车去上学。

name: but today, they are going to school on foot.
trans: 但是今天，他们要步行去上学。

name: Mrs. Sawyer usually stays at home in the morning,
trans: 索耶太太早上通常待在家里。

name: but this morning, she is going to the shops.
trans: 但是今天早上，她要去商店购物。

name: In the afternoon, Mrs. Sawyer usually drinks tea in the living room.
trans: 下午，索耶夫人通常会在客厅里喝茶。

name: But this afternoon, she is drinking tea in the garden.
trans: 但今天下午，她正在花园里喝茶。

name: In the evening, the children usually do their homework,
trans: 晚上，孩子们通常会做作业。

name: but this evening, they are not doing their homework.
trans: 但是今晚，他们没有做作业。

name: At the moment, they are playing in the garden.
trans: 他们现在正在花园里玩耍。

name: Mr. Sawyer usually reads his newspaper at night.
trans: 索耶先生通常在晚上读报纸。

name: But he's not reading his newspaper tonight.
trans: 但他今晚并没有看报纸。

name: At the moment, he's reading an interesting book.
trans: 目前，他正在读一本非常有趣的书。

name: Does the lady buy any chalk?
Do you want the large size or the small size?
trans: 您想要大号的还是小号的？

name: Do you have any writing paper?
Yes, we do.
trans: 是的，我们确实会这样做。

name: I don't have any small pads.
Yes, please.
trans: 好的，请告诉我您需要翻译的内容吧。

name: And I want a large box of chalk, too.
trans: 我还需要一盒大号的粉笔。

name: What is good news for Jimmy?
trans: 对吉米来说，有什么好消息？

name: Can you remember the doctor's telephone number?
trans: 你能记住医生的电话号码吗？

name: Show me your tongue. Say, 'Ah'.
trans: 把你的舌头伸出来，然后说“Ah”。

name: What's the matter with him, doctor?
He has a bad cold, Mr. Williams, so he must stay in bed for a week.
trans: 威廉姆斯先生得了重感冒，因此他必须卧床休息一周。

name: That's good news for Jimmy.
trans: 这对吉米来说是个好消息。

name: Who else is in bed today? Why?
trans: 今天还有谁在床上？为什么？

name: Can I see him please, Mrs. Williams?
trans: 请问威廉姆斯夫人，我能见见他吗？

name: You look very well, Jimmy.
trans: 你看起来气色很好，吉米。

name: You are better now, but you mustn't get up yet.
trans: 你现在好多了，但还不能起床哦。

name: You must stay in bed for another two days.
The boy mustn't go to school yet, Mrs. Williams.
trans: “这个男孩还不能去上学，威廉姆斯夫人。”

name: And he mustn't eat rich food.
trans: “而且他也不能吃油腻的食物。”

name: Does he have a temperature, doctor?
Yes. He must remain in bed for another two days.
He can get up for about two hours each day, but you must keep the room warm.
trans: “他每天可以起来大约两个小时，但你们必须保持房间温暖。”

name: He has a bad cold, too!
Does Jill take the key to the front door?
trans: 吉尔会拿前门的钥匙吗？

name: What are you going to do this evening, Jill?
trans: 今晚你打算做什么，吉尔？

name: I'm going to meet some friends, Dad.
trans: 爸爸，我要去见一些朋友。

name: You must be home at half past ten.
trans: 你必须在十点半之前到家。

name: I can't get home so early, Dad!
trans: 爸爸，我没办法这么早就回家啊！

name: Can I have the key to the front door, please?
trans: 请问，能给我前门的钥匙吗？

name: Jill's eighteen years old, Tom.
trans: 吉尔已经十八岁了，汤姆。

name: But you mustn't come home after a quarter past eleven.
trans: 但是你绝对不能在十一点四十五分之后才回家。

name: We always enjoy ourselves, Mum.
trans: 我们总是玩得很开心，妈妈。

name: What are the Johnsons going to do at the weekend?
trans: 约翰逊一家周末打算做什么？

name: Hello. Were you at the butcher's?
Were you at the butcher's, too?
Was he absent from school last week?
Yes, he was.
trans: 是的，他确实是那样的人。

name: He was absent on Monday, Tuesday, Wednesday and Thursday.
trans: 他周一、周二、周三和周四都缺席了。

name: How are you all keeping?
trans: 大家最近怎么样？过得还好吗？

name: We're going to spend three days in the country!
trans: 我们将在这个国家待上三天！

name: We're going to stay at my mother's for the weekend.
trans: 我们这个周末将住在妈妈家。

name: Friday, Saturday and Sunday in the country!
trans: 周五、周六和周日，我都在乡下！

name: Which car was the winner in 1995?
trans: 哪辆车在1995年赢得了比赛？

name: There is a car race near our town every year.
trans: 每年我们镇附近都会举行一场汽车比赛。

name: In 1995, there was a very big race.
trans: 1995年，有一场规模非常大的比赛。

name: There were hundreds of people there.
My wife and I were at the race.
trans: 我和我的妻子一起去了那场比赛。

name: Our friends Julie and Jack were there, too.
trans: 我们的朋友朱莉和杰克也都在那里。

name: You can see us in the crowd.
trans: 你们可以在人群中看到我们。

name: We are standing on the left.
There were twenty cars in the race.
trans: 比赛中共有二十辆汽车参与角逐。

name: There were English cars, French cars, German cars, Italian cars, American cars and Japanese cars.
trans: 有英国汽车、法国汽车、德国汽车、意大利汽车、美国汽车和日本汽车。

name: It was an exciting finish.
trans: 这是个令人兴奋的结局。

name: The winner was Billy Stewart.
trans: 获胜者是比利·斯图尔特。

name: He was in car number fifteen.
trans: 他坐在第十五号的车里。

name: Five other cars were just behind him.
trans: 还有另外五辆车紧跟在他后面。

name: On the way home, my wife said to me, 'Don't drive so quickly!
trans: 在回家的路上，我的妻子对我说：‘别开得太快！’

name: How did Pauline answer the telephone at nine o'clock?
trans: 保罗琳在九点钟是如何接电话的？

name: What's Ron Marston like, Pauline?
trans: 罗恩·马斯顿是个怎么样的人啊，保琳？

name: He telephoned me four times yesterday and three times the day before yesterday.
trans: 他昨天给我打了四次电话，前天则打了三次电话。

name: He telephoned the office yesterday morning and yesterday afternoon.
trans: 他昨天上午和昨天下午都给办公室打了电话。

name: What did your boss say to him?
trans: 你的老板对他说了什么？

name: She can't speak to you now!'
Then I arrived home at six o'clock yesterday evening.
trans: 然后我昨天晚上六点钟回到了家。

name: But I didn't answer the phone!
Did he telephone again last night?
trans: 他昨晚又打电话来了吗？

name: He telephoned at nine o'clock.
trans: 他是在九点钟打来的电话。

name: What did you say to him?
Please don't telephone my daughter again!'
trans: “请不要再给我女儿打电话了！”

name: The way to King Street
lesson: NCE1 · The Way to King Street

name: Why did the man need a phrasebook?
trans: 为什么那个人需要一本短语手册呢？
lesson: NCE1 · The Way to King Street

name: Last week Mrs. Mills went to London.
trans: 上周，米尔斯夫人去了伦敦。
lesson: NCE1 · The Way to King Street

name: She does not know London very well, and she lost her way.
trans: 她对伦敦不太熟悉，结果迷路了。
lesson: NCE1 · The Way to King Street

name: Suddenly, she saw a man near a bus stop.
trans: 突然，她在公交车站附近看到一个男人。
lesson: NCE1 · The Way to King Street

name: 'I can ask him the way,' she said to herself.
trans: “我可以问他路该怎么走，”她自言自语道。
lesson: NCE1 · The Way to King Street

name: 'Excuse me,' she said.
lesson: NCE1 · The Way to King Street

name: 'Can you tell me the way to King Street, please?'
trans: “请问您能告诉我去King Street的路吗？”
lesson: NCE1 · The Way to King Street

name: The man smiled pleasantly.
lesson: NCE1 · The Way to King Street

name: He did not understand English!
lesson: NCE1 · The Way to King Street

name: He spoke German.
lesson: NCE1 · The Way to King Street

name: He was a tourist.
lesson: NCE1 · The Way to King Street

name: Then he put his hand into his pocket, and took out a phrasebook.
trans: 然后他把手伸进口袋，拿出一本短语手册。
lesson: NCE1 · The Way to King Street

name: He opened the book and found a phrase.
trans: 他打开书，找到了一句话。
lesson: NCE1 · The Way to King Street

name: He read the phrase slowly.
trans: 他慢慢地读了这个短语。
lesson: NCE1 · The Way to King Street

name: 'I am sorry,' he said.
lesson: NCE1 · The Way to King Street

name: 'I do not speak English.'
lesson: NCE1 · The Way to King Street

name: What's wrong with the fashionable shoes?
trans: 这些时尚的鞋子有什么问题吗？

name: Do you have any shoes like these?
But my sister bought this pair last month.
trans: 不过这是我姐姐上个月买的这双鞋。

name: Did she buy them here?
trans: 她是在这里买的这些东西吗？

name: No, she bought them in the U. S.
trans: 不，她是在美国购买的这些商品。

name: We had some shoes like those a month ago, but we don't have any now.
trans: 我们一个月前还有一些那样的鞋子，但现在一只都没有了。

name: Can you get a pair for me, please?
They were in fashion last year and the year before last.
trans: 它们在去年和前年都很流行。

name: But they're not in fashion this year.
trans: 但它们今年已经过时了（不再流行了）。

name: These shoes are in fashion now.
They look very uncomfortable.
trans: 他们看起来非常不舒服。

name: But women always wear uncomfortable shoes!
trans: 但是女性总是穿着不舒服的鞋子啊！

name: What time of day is it, do you think? How do you know?
trans: 你觉得现在是什么时间？你是怎么知道的？

name: I want to see the dentist, please.
Can you come at 10 a.m. on Monday, April 24th?
trans: 你能于4月24日星期一上午10点来吗？

name: I must see the dentist now, nurse.
trans: 我现在必须去看牙医了，护士。

name: The dentist is very busy at the moment.
Can the dentist see me now?
trans: 牙医现在可以见我了吗？

name: I'm afraid that he can't, Mr. Croft.
trans: 恐怕他做不到，克罗夫特先生。

name: Can't you wait till this afternoon?
trans: 你就不能等到今天下午吗？

name: I can wait, but my toothache can't!
trans: 我可以等待，但我的牙痛却无法忍受！

name: What is Carol not going to buy?
I'm making a shopping list, Tom.
trans: 我在列购物清单呢，汤姆。

name: We need a lot of things this week.
trans: 这周我们需要很多东西。

name: I must go to the grocer's.
We haven't got much tea or coffee, and we haven't got any sugar or jam.
trans: 我们的茶和咖啡都不多了，糖和果酱也用完了。

name: I must go to the greengroce's.
We haven't got many tomatoes, but we've got a lot of potatoes.
trans: 我们的番茄不多，但是土豆有很多。

name: I must go to the butcher's, too.
We haven't got any meat at all.
trans: 我们根本没有任何肉了。

name: Have we got any beer and wine?
trans: 我们还有啤酒和葡萄酒吗？

name: And I'm not going to get any!
I hope that you've got some money.
Well, I haven't got much either!
trans: 嗯，我也没什么太多东西了！

name: Why is Carol disappointed?
trans: 为什么卡罗尔感到失望？

name: Have a glass of whisky then.
Is dinnner ready, Carol?
trans: 卡罗尔，晚餐准备好了吗？

name: We can have dinner at seven o'clock.
trans: 我们可以在七点钟吃晚饭。

name: Sam and I had lunch together today.
trans: 今天我和山姆一起吃了午饭。

name: We had roast beef and potatoes.
trans: 我们吃了烤牛肉和土豆。

name: Well, you're going to have roast beef and potatoes again tonight!
trans: 嗯，今晚你又可以吃烤牛肉和土豆了！

name: Where did Sam go for his holiday this year?
trans: 今年山姆去哪里度假了？

name: Do you want to have lunch with us?
trans: 你想和我们一起吃午饭吗？

name: I had lunch at half past twelve.
Have a cup of coffee then.
I've just had a cup, thank you.
I had one after my lunch.
Let's go into the living room, Carol.
trans: 我们一起去客厅吧，卡罗尔。

name: We can have our coffee there.
trans: 我们可以在那里喝咖啡。

name: Tom and I are going to have a holiday.
trans: 我和汤姆打算去度个假。

name: When are you going to have a holiday, Sam?
trans: 山姆，你什么时候能放假呢？

name: I've already had my holiday this year.
trans: 我今年已经度过了假期。

name: At what time of year did Ken visit Paris?
trans: 肯是在一年中的什么时候去巴黎的？

name: Have you just been to the cinema?
I saw it on television last year.
trans: 我去年在电视上看到过它。

name: It's an old film, but it's very good.
trans: 这是一部老电影，不过非常精彩。

name: Paris is a beautiful city.
trans: 巴黎是一座美丽的城市。

name: Have you ever been there, Ken?
It was spring, but the weather was awful.
trans: 虽然是春天，但天气却糟透了。

name: Can the mechanics repair Mr. Wood's car?
trans: 修车师傅们能修好伍德先生的车吗？

name: What's the number of your car?
When did you bring it to us?
trans: 您是什么时候把车送到我们这里的？

name: I brought it here three days ago.
trans: 我三天前把车送到这里的。

name: Ah yes, I remember now.
trans: 啊，对了，我现在想起来了。

name: Have your mechanics finished yet?
trans: 您的修车师傅们修好了吗？

name: No, they're still working on it.
trans: 不，他们仍在继续研究/开发这个项目。

name: Let's go into the garage and have a look at it.
Didn't you have a crash?
trans: 你的系统不是崩溃了吗？

name: I drove it into a lamp-post.
trans: 我把车开到了路灯柱上。

name: Can your mechanics repair it?
trans: 你们的机械师能修理它吗？

name: Well, they're trying to repair it, sir.
trans: 嗯，他们正在尝试修理它，先生。

name: But to tell you the truth, you need a new car!
trans: 但说实话，你真的需要一辆新车了！

name: Why couldn't Nigel decide?
trans: 为什么尼格尔无法做出决定？

name: I believe that this house is for sale.
That's right.
trans: 我认为这栋房子正在出售。

name: May I have a look at it, please?
How long have you lived here?
I've lived here for twenty years.
trans: 我在这里已经住了二十年。

name: Yes, I've been here since 1976.
trans: 是的，我从1976年就住在这里了。

name: Then why do you want to sell it?
trans: 那你为什么想卖掉它呢？

name: I want to buy a small house in the country.
trans: 我想在乡下买一座小房子。

name: How much does this house cost?
It's worth every penny of it.
Well, I like the house, but I can't decide yet.
trans: 嗯，我很喜欢这房子，但我还没决定下来。

name: My wife must see it first.
trans: 我得先让我妻子看看才行。

name: Women always have the last word.
trans: 女人总是有最终发言权。

name: Who wanted to sell the house?
Has Ian sold his house yet?
trans: 伊恩已经卖掉他的房子了吗？

name: Has he moved to his new house yet?
trans: 他已经搬进新房子了吗？

name: He has always been a good neighbour.
trans: 他一直是个很好的邻居。

name: When will the new people move into this house?
trans: 新搬来的人什么时候会入住这栋房子呢？

name: I think that they'll move in the day after tomorrow.
trans: 我认为他们会在后天搬进来。

name: Will you see Ian today, Jenny?
trans: 珍妮，你今天会见到伊恩吗？

name: Poor Ian! He didn't want to leave this house.
trans: 可怜的伊恩！他根本不想离开这栋房子。

name: No, he didn't want to leave, but his wife did!
trans: 不，他并不想离开，但他的妻子却想离开了！

name: Why is Nigel a lucky man?
trans: 为什么奈杰尔是个幸运的人？

name: Nigel is our new next-door neighbour.
trans: 奈杰尔是我们的新邻居，住在我们隔壁。

name: He was in the R.A.F.
trans: 他曾在英国皇家空军（R.A.F.）服役。

name: He will fly to New York next month.
The month after next he'll fly to Tokyo.
trans: 下下个月，他将飞往东京。

name: At the moment, he's in Madrid.
He flew to Spain a week ago.
trans: 他一周前飞去了西班牙。

name: He'll return to London the week after next.
trans: 他将在下下周回到伦敦。

name: and he has already been to nearly every country in the world.
trans: 他已经去过世界上几乎所有的国家了。

name: Nigel is a very lucky man.
trans: 奈杰尔是个非常幸运的人。

name: But his wife isn't very lucky.
trans: 不过他的妻子运气不太好。

name: Why did George and Ken miss the train?
trans: 为什么乔治和肯错过了火车？

name: Two return tickets to London, please.
trans: 请给我两张去伦敦的往返机票。

name: What time will the next train leave?
trans: 下一班火车什么时候出发？

name: Over the bridge.
trans: （用于鼓励某人克服困难或完成某件事）再坚持一下，就成功了。

name: What time will the next train leave?
trans: 下一班火车什么时候出发？

name: We've got plenty of time.
trans: 我们还有 plenty of time（大量的时间）。

name: It's only three minutes to eight.
trans: 距离八点还只有三分钟。

name: Let's go and have a drink.
There's a bar next door to the station.
We had better go back to the station now, Ken.
trans: 我们最好现在就回车站去，肯。

name: We want to catch the eight nineteen to London.
trans: 我们想搭乘89次航班去伦敦。

name: When's the next train?
trans: 下一班火车什么时候到？

name: Does Mr. Hall get his case back?
trans: 霍尔先生能拿回他的案子吗？

name: I left a suitcase on the train to London the other day.
trans: 前几天，我把一个行李箱忘在了开往伦敦的火车上。

name: Can you describe it, sir?
trans: 先生，您能描述一下它吗？

name: It's a small blue case and it's got a zip.
trans: 这是一个蓝色的小盒子，上面有一个拉链。

name: There's a label on the handle with my name and address on it.
trans: 把手上有一个标签，上面写着我的名字和地址。

name: What's your name and address?
trans: 你叫什么名字，住在哪里？

name: This case doesn't belong to me!
You've given me the wrong case!
Must Andy go to see the doctor?
I think that I've hurt my back.
trans: 我觉得我的背部受了伤。

name: I'm afraid that I can't get up.
I think that the doctor had better see you.
trans: 我觉得医生最好还是见见你。

name: I'll phone Dr. Carter.
trans: 我会给卡特医生打电话。

name: The doctor says that he will come at once.
I'm sure that you need an X-ray, Andy.
trans: 我肯定你需要做一次X光检查，安迪。

name: Does grandmother seem pleased to get a card from Jimmy? Why/Why not?
trans: 奶奶收到吉米送的卡片时，看起来很高兴吗？为什么呢？

name: Read Jimmy's card to me please, Penny.
trans: 请把吉米的卡片内容读给我听，佩妮。

name: 'I have just arrived in Scotland and I'm staying at a Youth Hostel.'
trans: 我刚到苏格兰，现在住在一家青年旅舍里。

name: He says he's just arrived in Scotland.
trans: 他说他刚刚抵达苏格兰。

name: He says he's staying at a Youth Hostel.
trans: 他说他现在住在一家青年旅舍里。

name: You know he's a member of the Y.H.A.
trans: 你知道他是 Y.H.A. 的成员。

name: I hope you are all well.'
trans: 我希望你们大家都一切都好。

name: I'm afraid I can't hear you.
He says he'll write a letter soon.
trans: 他说他很快就会写一封信。

name: He hopes we are all well.
trans: 他希望我们所有人都安好。

name: He doesn't say very much, does he?
He can't write very much on a card, Mum.
trans: 妈妈，他在卡片上写不了太多内容。

name: How long did the exam last?
How was the exam, Richard?
trans: 理查德，考试考得怎么样？

name: I think I passed in English and Mathematics.
trans: 我想我英语和数学都考及格了。

name: The English and Maths papers weren't easy enough for me.
trans: 英语和数学的试卷对我来说难度确实太大了一些。

name: I think I failed the French paper.
trans: 我觉得我法语考试没及格。

name: I could answer sixteen of the questions.
trans: 我能够回答其中的十六个问题。

name: But I couldn't answer the rest.
trans: 但我无法回答其余的问题。

name: They were too difficult for me.
French tests are awful, aren't they?
trans: 法语考试真的很难考，对吧？

name: I'm sure I've got a low mark.
Perhaps we didn't do too badly.
trans: 也许我们的表现还不错。

name: The guy next to me wrote his name at the top of the paper.
trans: 坐在我旁边的人在纸的顶部写下了自己的名字。

name: Then he sat there and looked at it for three hours!
trans: 然后他就坐在那里，盯着那个东西看了三个小时！

name: What was Sandra's present?
trans: 桑德拉收到了什么礼物？

name: Do you want to speak to her?
I want her to come to my office.
trans: 我希望她能来我的办公室。

name: Tell her to come at once.
Did you want to see me?
You've typed it with only one 'L'.
trans: 你只用了一个“L”来拼写它。

name: This letter's full of mistakes.
trans: 这个拼写里有很多错误。

name: I want you to type it again.
I'm sorry about that.
trans: 关于刚才的错误，我很抱歉。

name: And here's a little present for you.
trans: 这里有一个小礼物给你。

name: I hope it'll help you.
trans: 希望这能对你有所帮助。

name: What kind of dress does the Lady want?
trans: 这位女士想要什么样的裙子呢？

name: Do you like this dress, madam?
trans: 夫人，您喜欢这条裙子吗？

name: I like the colour very much.
It's a lovely dress, but it's too small for me.
trans: 这条裙子很漂亮，不过对我来说太小了。

name: It's a lovely dress.
trans: 这是一条非常漂亮的裙子。

name: Short skirts are in fashion now.
Would you like to try it?
I'm afraid this green dress is too small for me as well.
trans: 恐怕这条绿色的裙子对我来说也太小了。

name: It's smaller than the blue one.
trans: 它比那个蓝色的东西要小。

name: I don't like the colour either.
It doesn't suit me at all.
I think the blue dress is prettier.
trans: 我觉得那条蓝色的裙子更漂亮。

name: Could you show me another blue dress?
trans: 你能再给我看一件蓝色的连衣裙吗？

name: I want a dress like that one, but it must be my size.
trans: 我想要一条像那样的裙子，但它必须是我的尺码。

name: I'm afraid I haven't got a larger dress.
trans: 恐怕我没有更大号的裙子了。

name: This is the largest dress in the shop.
trans: 这是店里最大号的连衣裙。

name: What does Jane have with her coffee?
Shall I make some coffee, Jane?
One and a half teaspoonfuls, please.
trans: 请给我一茶半茶匙的量。

name: Yes, please.
trans: 好的，请告诉我您需要翻译的内容吧。

name: I think there are a few in that box.
trans: 我觉得那个盒子里有几件东西。

name: Can Mr. Frith buy the television on instalments? How does it work?
trans: 弗里斯先生可以分期付款购买这台电视机吗？具体是怎么操作的？

name: I like this television very much.
trans: 我非常喜欢这台电视机。

name: It's the most expensive model in the shop.
We can't afford all that money.
trans: 我们负担不起那么多钱。

name: This model's less expensive than that one.
trans: 这个模型的价格比那个模型便宜。

name: But, of course, it's not as good as the expensive one.
trans: 但是，当然了，它没有那个昂贵的模型好。

name: The other model's more expensive, but it's worth the money.
trans: 另一个型号虽然更贵，但它的价格确实物有所值。

name: Can we buy it on instalments?
trans: 我们可以分期付款购买吗？

name: You can pay a deposit of thirty pounds,
trans: 你可以先支付30英镑的定金，

name: and then fourteen pounds a month for three years.
trans: 然后每月支付14英镑，共分三年。

name: I certainly do, but I don't like the price.
trans: 我当然喜欢，只是价格让我有些犹豫。

name: You always want the best, but we can't afford it.
trans: 你总是想要最好的东西，但我们负担不起……

name: Sometimes you think you're a millionaire!
trans: 有时候你真觉得自己是个百万富翁啊！

name: Millionaires don't buy things on instalments!
trans: 百万富翁才不会分期付款买东西呢！

name: Who has got some small change?
I can't change a ten-pound note.
trans: 我无法兑换一张十英镑的纸币。

name: Haven't you got any small change?
I'll ask some of the passengers.
Have you any small change, sir?
Can you change this ten-pound note, madam?
trans: 女士，您能帮我兑换这张十英镑的纸币吗？

name: You must get off the bus.
None of our passengers can change this note.
trans: 我们的任何乘客都无法更改这条留言。

name: What does Jim have to drink?
I'm sure there's no one at home.
Carol and Tom invited us to lunch.
trans: 卡罗尔和汤姆邀请我们吃午饭了……

name: Everybody wants to have lunch in the garden.
trans: 大家都想在花园里吃午饭。

name: It's nice and warm out here.
trans: 外面天气很暖和，很舒服。

name: Come and have something to drink.
May I have a glass of beer please?
What does she mean by 'change' in the last sentence?
trans: 她在最后一句话里说的“change”是什么意思？

name: When my husband was going into the dining room this morning,
trans: 今天早上，当我丈夫走进餐厅的时候……

name: he dropped some coins on the floor.
trans: 他把一些硬币掉在了地上。

name: We looked for them, but we could not find them all.
trans: 我们寻找过他们，但没能找到所有人。

name: While we were having breakfast,
trans: 当我们正在吃早餐的时候……

name: our little boy, Tommy, found two small coins on the floor.
trans: 我们的小男孩汤米在地板上发现了两枚小硬币。

name: He put them both into his mouth.
trans: 他把它们都放进了嘴里。

name: We both tried to get the coins, but it was too late.
trans: 我们都试图拿到那些硬币，但已经太晚了。

name: Tommy had already swallowed them!
trans: 汤米已经把它们吞下去了！

name: Late that morning, when I was doing the housework,
trans: 那天上午晚些时候，当我正在做家务时……

name: My husband phoned me from the office.
trans: 我丈夫从办公室给我打了电话。

name: 'Tommy's been to the toilet three times this morning, but I haven't had any change yet!'
trans: “今天早上汤米已经去了三次厕所了，但我还没有收到任何零钱呢！”

name: Who called out to the thieves in the dark?
trans: 是谁在黑暗中向那些小偷喊叫的？

name: I want to tell you a true story.
trans: 我想告诉你一个真实的故事。

name: It happened to a friend of mine a year ago.
trans: 这件事发生在我一个朋友身上，是在一年前。

name: While my friend, George, was reading in bed,
trans: 当我的朋友乔治在床上读书的时候，

name: two thieves climbed into his kitchen.
trans: 两个小偷爬进了他的厨房。

name: After they had entered the house,
they went into the dining room.
It was very dark, so they turned on a torch.
trans: 天非常黑，于是他们点燃了一支火把。

name: Suddenly, they heard a voice behind them.
trans: 突然，他们听到身后传来一个声音。

name: 'What's up? What's up?' someone called.
trans: “怎么了？出什么事了？”有人喊道。

name: The thieves dropped the torch and ran away as quickly as they could.
trans: 小偷们扔掉了火把，然后以最快的速度逃跑了。

name: George heard the noise and came downstairs quickly.
trans: 乔治听到了那个声音，立刻快步下楼去了。

name: He turned on the light, but he couldn't see anyone.
trans: 他打开了灯，却看不到任何人。

name: But George's parrot, Henry, was still there.
trans: 但是乔治的鹦鹉亨利还在那里。

name: The man in a hat
lesson: NCE1 · The Man in a Hat

name: Why didn't Caroline recognize the customer straight away?
trans: 为什么卡罗琳没有立刻认出那位顾客？
lesson: NCE1 · The Man in a Hat

name: I bought two expensive dictionaries here half an hour ago, but I forgot to take them with me.
trans: 半小时前我在这里买了两本昂贵的词典，但忘记带走了。
lesson: NCE1 · The Man in a Hat

name: Who served you, sir?
lesson: NCE1 · The Man in a Hat

name: The lady who is standing behind the counter.
trans: 是站在柜台后面的那位女士。
lesson: NCE1 · The Man in a Hat

name: Which books did you buy?
lesson: NCE1 · The Man in a Hat

name: The books which are on the counter.
trans: 就是放在柜台上的那些书。
lesson: NCE1 · The Man in a Hat

name: Did you serve this gentleman half an hour ago, Caroline?
trans: 卡罗琳，半小时前您为这位先生服务过吗？
lesson: NCE1 · The Man in a Hat

name: He says he's the man who bought these books.
trans: 他说他就是买这些书的人。
lesson: NCE1 · The Man in a Hat

name: I can't remember.
lesson: NCE1 · The Man in a Hat

name: The man who I served was wearing a hat.
trans: 那个我服务过的男人戴着一顶帽子。
lesson: NCE1 · The Man in a Hat

name: Have you got a hat, sir?
lesson: NCE1 · The Man in a Hat

name: Yes, I have.
lesson: NCE1 · The Man in a Hat

name: Would you put it on, please?
lesson: NCE1 · The Man in a Hat

name: All right.
lesson: NCE1 · The Man in a Hat

name: Is this the man that you served, Caroline?
trans: 这就是您服务过的那个人吗，卡罗琳？
lesson: NCE1 · The Man in a Hat

name: Yes.
lesson: NCE1 · The Man in a Hat

name: I recognize him now.
lesson: NCE1 · The Man in a Hat

name: Who is the man with the beard?
trans: 那个留着胡子的男人是谁？

name: This is a photograph I took during my trip to Australia.
trans: 这是我在澳大利亚旅行时拍的照片。

name: They're people I met during the trip.
trans: 他们是我在旅行中遇到的人。

name: That's the ship we travelled on.
That's the man I told you about.
The one who offered you a job in Australia.
trans: “就是那个在澳大利亚给你提供工作机会的人。”

name: I grew a beard during the trip, but I shaved it off when I came home.
trans: “我在旅途中留了胡子，但回家后就把它刮掉了。”

name: Why did you shave it off?
Tea for two
trans: “Tea for two” 的意思是“为两个人准备的茶”。

name: Does Susan have tea by herself?
Can't you come in and have tea now, Peter?
trans: 彼得，你现在就不能进来喝杯茶吗？

name: I must water the garden first.
Do you have to water it now?
What a nuisance!
trans: 真是个讨厌的家伙（或东西）！

name: Last summer it was very dry, too.
I had to water it every day.
trans: 我每天都必须给它浇水。

name: Well, I'll have tea by myself.
trans: 好吧，我就自己喝杯茶吧。

name: That means you don't need to water the garden.
trans: 这意味着你不需要给花园浇水了。

name: That was a pleasant surprise.
trans: 这真是个令人愉快的惊喜。

name: It means I can have tea, instead.
trans: 这意味着我可以喝茶来代替（之前的选择）。

name: Who is only twenty-nine, and why is it so unclear?
trans: 谁的年龄只有29岁？为什么这一点如此难以确定呢？

name: Can you recognize that woman, Liz?
trans: 你能认出那个女人吗，莉兹？

name: It must be Karen Marsh, the actress.
trans: 那一定是凯伦·马什，那位女演员。

name: That must be Conrad Reeves.
trans: 那一定是康拉德·里夫斯吧。

name: Conrad Reeves, the actor?
trans: 康拉德·里夫斯，那位演员？

name: Isn't he her third husband?
trans: 他不是她的第三任丈夫吗？

name: He must be her fourth or fifth.
trans: 他应该是她的第四或第五任丈夫吧。

name: Doesn't Karen Marsh look old!
trans: 凯伦·马什看起来确实很老了！

name: I read she's twenty-nine, but she must be at least forty.
trans: 我记得她才29岁，但实际上她至少有40岁了。

name: I'm sure she is.
trans: 我敢肯定她确实有40岁了。

name: She was a famous actress when I was still at school.
trans: 我还在上学的时候，她还是个著名的演员呢。

name: That was a long time ago, wasn't it?
trans: 那已经是很久以前的事了，对吧？

name: Not that long ago!
trans: 其实并没有那么久以前！

name: I'm not more than twenty-nine myself.
trans: 我自己也不过二十九岁而已。

name: What does Ann advise her husband to do next time?
trans: 安建议她丈夫下次该怎么做？

name: That policeman's waving to you.
trans: 那个警察正在向你挥手。

name: Where do you think you are?
You must have been driving at seventy miles an hour.
trans: 你当时肯定是以每小时70英里的速度在开车。

name: I was doing eighty when I overtook you.
trans: 当我超过你的时候，我的速度是每小时八十公里。

name: Didn't you see the speed limit?
I was telling him to drive slowly.
trans: 我当时在告诉他要开慢一点。

name: That's why I didn't see the sign.
trans: 这就是为什么我没有看到那个标志的原因。

name: Let me see your driving licence.
trans: 请让我看一下你的驾驶执照。

name: I won't charge you this time.
But you'd better not do it again!
trans: 但你最好别再这么做了！

name: I told you to drive slowly, Gary.
trans: 我早就告诉过你要开慢一点，加里。

name: You always tell me to drive slowly, darling.
trans: 你总是让我开慢车，亲爱的。

name: Well, next time you'd better take my advice!
trans: 嗯，下次你最好还是听我的建议吧！

name: What's the problem about deciding on a holiday?
trans: 决定去哪里度假有什么困难吗？

name: Where are you going to spend your holidays this year, Gary?
trans: 加里，今年你打算在哪里度过假期呢？

name: My wife wants to go to Egypt.
I'd like to go there, too.
We can't make up our minds.
Will you travel by sea or by air?
trans: 你们会选择乘船还是乘飞机出行呢？

name: It may be cheaper, but it takes a long time.
trans: 虽然这种方式可能更便宜，但所需的时间会很长。

name: I'm sure you'll enjoy yourselves.
trans: 我相信你们会玩得很开心的。

name: We might not go anywhere.
trans: 我们可能根本不会取得任何进展（或：我们可能什么都不会做成）。

name: My wife always worries too much.
trans: 我妻子总是过于担心了。

name: Who's going to look after the dog?
Who's going to look after the house?
trans: 谁来负责照看这栋房子呢？

name: Who's going to look after the garden?
trans: 谁来负责照看这个花园呢？

name: We have this problem every year.
trans: 我们每年都会遇到这个问题。

name: In the end, we stay at home and look after everything!
trans: 最终，我们还是待在家里，负责照顾所有的事情！

name: What reasons did Karen Marsh give for wanting to retire?
trans: 凯伦·马什提出了哪些想要退休的理由？

name: Have you just made a new film, Miss Marsh?
trans: 马什小姐，您刚刚完成了一部新电影的制作吗？

name: Are you going to make another?
I don't want to make another film for a long time.
trans: 我很长时间都不想再拍电影了。

name: 'Karen Marsh: Sensational News!
trans: 凯伦·马什：这可真是轰动性的新闻！

name: By our reporter, Alan Jones.
trans: 由我们的记者艾伦·琼斯报道。

name: Karen Marsh arrived at London Airport today.
trans: 凯伦·马什今天抵达了伦敦机场。

name: She was wearing a blue dress and a mink coat.
trans: 她穿着一条蓝色的连衣裙和一件貂皮大衣。

name: She told me she had just made a new film.
trans: 她告诉我她刚刚完成了一部新电影的制作。

name: she said she was not going to make another.
trans: 她说她不会再制作另一个了。

name: She said she was going to retire.
She told reporters she felt very tired and didn't want to make another film for a long time.'
trans: 她对记者们表示，她感到非常疲惫，暂时不想再拍电影了。

name: Is Karen Marsh going to retire, do you think?
trans: 你觉得凯伦·马什会退休吗？

name: Are you really going to retire, Miss Marsh?
trans: 马什小姐，你真的打算退休吗？

name: I can't make up my mind.
I will have to ask my future husband.
He won't let me make another film.
trans: 他不会允许我再拍电影了。

name: Your future husband, Miss Marsh?
trans: 你的未婚夫吗，马什小姐？

name: Let me introduce him to you.
trans: 让我来介绍一下他给你听。

name: We're going to get married next week.
Here's another report about Karen Marsh.
trans: 这是另一份关于凯伦·马什的报告。

name: At her London Hotel today Miss Marsh told reporters she might retire.
trans: 今天在伦敦的酒店里，马什小姐对记者们表示她可能会退休。

name: She said she couldn't make up her mind.
She said she would have to ask her future husband.
trans: 她说她必须先征求她未来丈夫的意见。

name: She said her future husband would not let her make another film.
trans: 她说她的未来丈夫不会允许她再拍电影了。

name: Then she introduced us to Carlos and told us they would get married next week.'
trans: 然后她把我们介绍给了卡洛斯，并告诉我们他们下周就要结婚了。

name: That's sensational news, isn't it, Kate?
trans: 这真是个惊人的消息，对吧，凯特？

name: He'll be her sixth husband!
trans: 他将成为她的第六任丈夫！

name: What would Julie like to do, if she had the money?
trans: 如果朱莉有钱，她想做什么？

name: Are you doing the football pools, Brain?
trans: 你正在参与足球彩票投注吗，布莱恩？

name: I'm sure we'll win something this week.
trans: 我肯定我们这周会赢点什么钱的。

name: You always say that, but we never win anything!
trans: 你总是这么说，但我们从来都没赢过！

name: What will you do if you win a lot of money?
trans: 如果你赢了很多钱，你会做什么？

name: If I win a lot of money I'll buy you a mink coat.
trans: 如果我赢了很多钱，我会给你买一件貂皮大衣。

name: I don't want a mink coat!
I want to see the world.
If we win a lot of money we'll travel round the world and we'll stay at the best hotels.
trans: 如果我们赚了很多钱，我们就打算环游世界，并且入住最好的酒店。

name: Then we'll return home and buy a big house in the country.
trans: 然后我们就回家，在乡下买一座大房子。

name: We'll have a beautiful garden and...
trans: 我们将拥有一个美丽的花园，还有……

name: But if we spend all that money we'll be poor again.
trans: 但是如果我们把所有的钱都花掉了，我们又会变得穷困了。

name: If we spend all the money we'll try and win the football pools again.
trans: 如果我们把所有的钱都花掉，就再试着赢一次足球彩票吧。

name: It's a pleasant dream but everything depends on 'if' !
trans: 这确实是一个美好的梦想，但一切都取决于“是否”能够实现它！

name: Which John Smith does Graham Turner think he is talking to?
trans: 格雷厄姆·特纳认为他正在和哪个叫“约翰·史密斯”的人交谈呢？

name: Tell Mary we'll be late for dinner this evening.
trans: 告诉玛丽，我们今晚吃晚饭会迟到。

name: Hasn't Mary told you?
trans: 玛丽不是已经告诉你了吗？

name: She invited Charlotte and me to dinner this evening.
trans: 她邀请了夏洛特和我今晚一起吃晚餐。

name: I said I would be at your house at six o'clock, but the boss wants me to do some extra work.
trans: 我说过六点会去你家，但老板让我去做一些额外的工作。

name: I'll have to stay at the office.
I don't know when I'll finish.
trans: 我不知道我什么时候能完成这项工作。

name: Oh, and by the way, my wife wants to know if Mary needs any help.
trans: 哦，顺便问一下，我妻子想知道玛丽是否需要帮忙。

name: I don't know what you're talking about.
That is John Smith, isn't it?
trans: 那个人是约翰·史密斯，对吧？

name: Yes, I'm John Smith.
trans: 是的，我就是约翰·史密斯。

name: You are John Smith, the engineer, aren't you?
trans: 你是那位工程师约翰·史密斯，对吗？

name: You work for the Overseas Engineering Company, don't you?
trans: 你在海外工程公司工作，对吗？

name: I'm John Smith the telephone engineer and I'm repairing your telephone line.
trans: 我是电话工程师约翰·史密斯，我正在修理你们的电话线路。

name: Sally's first train ride
trans: 莎莉的第一次火车旅行

name: Why was the mother embarrassed?
trans: 为什么那位母亲感到尴尬？

name: Last week, my four-year-old daughter, Sally, was invited to a children's party.
trans: 上周，我四岁的女儿莎莉被邀请参加一个儿童派对。

name: I decided to take her by train.
trans: 上周，我四岁的女儿莎莉被邀请参加一个儿童派对。我决定带她坐火车去。

name: Sally was very excited because she had never travelled on a train before.
trans: 莎莉非常兴奋，因为她以前从未坐过火车。

name: She sat near the window and asked questions about everything she saw.
trans: 她坐在窗边，对看到的一切都充满了好奇，不停地提问。

name: Suddenly, a middle-age lady got on the train and sat opposite Sally.
trans: 突然，一位中年女士上了火车，坐在莎莉的对面。

name: Sally did not answer, but looked at her curiously.
trans: 莎莉没有回答，只是好奇地盯着她看。

name: The lady was dressed in a blue coat and a large, funny hat.
trans: 那位女士穿着一件蓝色外套，戴着一顶又大又有趣的帽子。

name: After the train had left the station, the lady opened her handbag and took out her powder compact.
trans: 火车离开车站后，那位女士打开她的手提包，拿出了她的粉饼。

name: She then began to make up her face.
'Why are you doing that?' Sally asked.
trans: “你为什么要那么做？”莎莉问道。

name: 'To make myself beautiful,' the lady answered.
trans: “为了让自己变得更美丽，”那位女士回答道。

name: She put away her compact and smiled kindly.
trans: 她收起了她的相机，然后露出了友善的微笑。

name: 'But you are still ugly,' Sally said.
Sally was amused, but I was very embarrassed!
trans: 莎莉觉得这很有趣，但我却感到非常尴尬！

name: A walk through the woods
lesson: NCE1 · A Walk Through the Woods

name: What was so funny about the words on the sign?
trans: 那个招牌上的文字有什么好笑的呢？
lesson: NCE1 · A Walk Through the Woods

name: I live in a very old town which is surrounded by beautiful woods.
trans: 我住在一个非常古老的城镇里，这个城镇被美丽的树林环绕着。
lesson: NCE1 · A Walk Through the Woods

name: It is a famous beauty spot.
trans: 这是一个著名的风景优美、景色宜人的地方。
lesson: NCE1 · A Walk Through the Woods

name: On Sundays, hundreds of people come from the city to see our town and to walk through the woods.
trans: 每到周日，都会有数百人从城里来到我们这个小镇，然后漫步在树林里。
lesson: NCE1 · A Walk Through the Woods

name: Visitors have been asked to keep the woods clean and tidy.
trans: 游客们被要求保持森林的整洁和干净。
lesson: NCE1 · A Walk Through the Woods

name: Litter baskets have been placed under the trees, but people still throw their rubbish everywhere.
trans: 虽然树底下已经放置了垃圾篓，人们仍然把垃圾扔得到处都是。
lesson: NCE1 · A Walk Through the Woods

name: Last Wednesday, I went for a walk in the woods.
trans: 上周三，我去树林里散步了。
lesson: NCE1 · A Walk Through the Woods

name: What I saw made me very sad.
trans: 我所看到的一切让我感到非常难过。
lesson: NCE1 · A Walk Through the Woods

name: I counted seven old cars and three old refrigerators.
trans: 我数了七辆旧汽车和三台旧冰箱。
lesson: NCE1 · A Walk Through the Woods

name: The little baskets were empty and the ground was covered with pieces of paper,
trans: 那些小篮子都是空的，地面上散落着许多纸片。
lesson: NCE1 · A Walk Through the Woods

name: cigarette ends, old tyres, empty bottles and rusty tins.
trans: 烟头、旧轮胎、空瓶子以及生锈的铁罐。
lesson: NCE1 · A Walk Through the Woods

name: Among the rubbish, I found a sign which said, 'Anyone who leaves litter in these woods will be prosecuted!'
trans: 在那些垃圾中，我发现了一张告示，上面写着：“任何在这些树林里乱扔垃圾的人都将受到法律追究！”
lesson: NCE1 · A Walk Through the Woods
